report.summary: bad_feature_flag in orders: deepest failing spans are in orders

timeline.event: orders: enable tax_v2 regional VAT calculation

hypotheses.reasoning: deepest failing spans are in orders

root_cause.summary: deepest failing spans are in orders

fix.diff:
--- a/config/orders.toml
+++ b/config/orders.toml
@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
 # orders: order creation, tax, inventory reservation, payment, fulfilment message
-version = "1.7.4"
+version = "1.7.3"
 memory_limit_mb = 130
 
@@ -9,5 +9,5 @@
 
 [flags]
-tax_v2 = true
+tax_v2 = false
 
 [inventory]

ground_truth.explanation: tax_v2 looks up VAT by region but VAT_BY_REGION has no entry for PT-20 and PT-30 (Azores, Madeira), so those orders raise KeyError and return 500.

changes.author: sofia
changes.title: orders: enable tax_v2 regional VAT calculation

changes.author: ines
changes.title: worker: bump version after dependency update

+version = "1.7.4"
 memory_limit_mb = 130
 
@@ -9,5 +9,5 @@
 
 [flags]
-tax_v2 = false
+tax_v2 = true
 
 [inventory]
